# Chocolate Cake

## Ingredients

- 6 egg yolks
- 1 cupful sugar
- grated rind and juice of 1/2 lemon
- 1/2 cake grated bitter chocolate
- 1 teaspoonful baking-powder
- pinch of cinnamon
- pinch of clove
- flour, enough to make a thin batter
- 3 egg whites, stiffly beaten
- currant jelly, for filling
- 1 egg, beaten (for frosting)
- 1 cupful powdered sugar (for frosting)
- 1/2 teaspoonful vanilla (for frosting)

## Instructions

1. Beat the yolks of six eggs.
2. Add a cupful of sugar, and the grated rind and juice of half a lemon.
3. Sift in half a cake of grated bitter chocolate, a teaspoonful of baking-powder, with a pinch each of cinnamon, and clove, and enough flour to make a thin batter.
4. Fold in the stiffly beaten whites of the eggs.
5. Bake in layer-cake pans.
6. Put together with currant jelly.
7. Ice with frosting made of a beaten egg, a cupful of powdered sugar, and half a teaspoonful of vanilla.
